description: Opens a review of a branch the person pushed (with a push code token from create_code_token, or to the workspace's own GitHub), as a pull request does on GitHub: CodeGene opens the branch's review, builds its preview at exactly headSha, and the new task moves to Try it once the preview is ready. A later push to the branch moves the review to the new commit and rebuilds its preview (the task returns to Try it once that preview is ready), as a pull request follows its branch; going live merges the commit the preview shows. A branch alone builds no preview. Needs the branch name and the full commit id it was pushed at (git rev-parse HEAD). Never the branch the project goes live from. In a project of several parts, part names the one the change is about. The same branch and commit answer the same task.

branch.description: The pushed branch that holds the work.

detail.description: More about the change, kept on the task.

headSha.description: The full 40-character commit id the branch was pushed at.

part.description: For a project of several parts (for example its app and its marketing site): the slug of the part the change is about, so its preview opens on that part. Left out, a project with one part uses it, and in a project of several the preview opens on the newest part the branch built. An unknown slug is refused with the slugs the project has.

projectId.description: The project the work is for.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

title.description: What the change does, as the task's title.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: open_review
title: Open a review of a pushed branch
